description: Create a field-service order and return its status URL. HTTP 201 returns a created order; HTTP 202 returns an order accepted_pending_fulfilment with fulfilled=false. Order creation requires a provisioned integration key through x-api-key. MCP also accepts that key through Authorization: Bearer; direct REST order creation requires x-api-key. A self-serve OAuth token authenticates but is not entitled to create orders: HTTP 402 payment_required (JSON-RPC -32002 over MCP). Anonymous callers receive HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate. To be provisioned, POST JSON to https://steadywrk.app/api/integration-key-request or use https://steadywrk.app/developers/keys and a person reviews each request. Email fallback: hello@steadywrk.app.

test_mode.description: true: a test booking with your STEADYWRK key (any key, including the free one). Answered whether orders are open or not, marked test: true; nothing is dispatched, matched or charged.

trade.description: Trade code, as listed by dispatch.index (e.g. plumbing, hvac, electrical).

name: dispatch.order

outputSchema.description: A recorded work order — fulfilled (contractor matched, HTTP 201) or accepted_pending_fulfilment (no contractor yet, HTTP 202) — or a business/entitlement error passthrough.
